scripts.build:prod: npm run build:legacy && vite build --mode production
scripts.lint: npm run type-check && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:css-vars
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['static/dist', 'static/js', 'node_modules/.vite'].forEach(dir => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));"
scripts.help: echo 'Development: npm run dev (+ cargo run in another terminal)'
